description.value:
You're surrounded by thick smoke.

Smoke is hard to see through. Visual Perception checks take a circumstance penalty that depends on how thick it is, anything seen through a lot of it is concealed, and you can't see beyond half a mile at most. Close to a wildfire, the smoke and superheated air leave you holding your breath or suffocating.

Basic environmental protection doesn't filter smoke. Under the Enhanced Rules, an advanced filtered air supply does.
